title: Junior AI/ML Developer (Python)
description: Join a small product team as a junior AI/ML developer. Work with Python to clean and analyse data, train and evaluate machine learning models, and help ship them as simple APIs (FastAPI) with senior guidance. Freshers and 0-2 years of experience are welcome; academic and personal projects count. We value strong fundamentals, curiosity and clear communication over advanced theory.

requirements.text: Python fundamentals: functions, data structures, OOP basics, error handling, writing clean and testable code
Machine learning fundamentals: supervised vs unsupervised learning, train/test split, overfitting and underfitting, bias-variance, evaluation metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1)
Data handling with pandas and NumPy: cleaning, missing values, exploratory analysis, feature engineering, avoiding data leakage
Hands-on ML projects with scikit-learn or PyTorch/TensorFlow, and basic awareness of LLM/GenAI concepts (prompting, embeddings, RAG)
Basics of serving and shipping models: FastAPI or Flask, Git, Docker, and simple deployment ideas
Communication, learning attitude and ownership: explains clearly, handles feedback, learns new tools on their own

rules: This is a JUNIOR role: test fundamentals and practical understanding, not senior-level system design or research theory.
Accept college, internship, Kaggle and personal projects as real experience; ask what the candidate personally did.
Hard questions must still be junior-appropriate, for example: a model has 99 percent training accuracy but poor test accuracy, what would you check; or how would you spot data leakage.
Ask for concrete examples, numbers and simple explanations in plain words; probe vague answers once.
Keep the tone friendly, patient and encouraging; do not argue or teach during the interview.
If the candidate asks about salary, selection status or company policy, say the hiring team will follow up.
